title: BBQ Chicken Thighs with Corn and Sweet Potato
summary: Juicy chicken thighs are coated in a simple smoky-sweet barbecue glaze and roasted with tender sweet potato and sweetcorn. It’s a comforting, crowd-pleasing dinner with bold American-style flavour.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Line a large baking tray with baking paper if you have it.
Cut the sweet potatoes into bite-sized chunks. Toss them with 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon black pepper. Spread them on the tray and roast for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the ketchup, brown sugar, cider vinegar, mustard, water, paprika, garlic powder, and a pinch of salt in a bowl to make the barbecue sauce.
Pat the chicken thighs dry, season with the remaining salt and pepper, then toss with the barbecue sauce until well coated.
Remove the tray from the oven, add the sweetcorn and chicken thighs, and turn the sweet potatoes. Drizzle the sweetcorn with the remaining olive oil.
Return to the oven and roast for 20 to 25 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, the juices run clear, and the sweet potatoes are browned at the edges.
If you want a stickier glaze, brush the chicken with any extra sauce and roast for 3 to 5 minutes more. Serve the chicken with the roasted sweet potato and sweetcorn.
